To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have introduced a new kernel that allows us to learn a representation of atomic structures that is transparent, well principled, and can be used for a wide range of tasks, including the construction of a data driven periodic table of the element.

(i) the SOAP kernel is a very useful tool for the construction of ML models for the prediction of atomic scale properties, (ii) the performance of such models can be improved by introducing a multi-scale description of atomic interactions and a description of the correlations between chemical species, (iii) the optimal model of the element correlations that we found shows striking similarities with the traditional Periodic Table of elements, and (iv) this suggests that the Periodic Table might be a consequence of a simple optimization problem
